# Copilot Instructions for manicmeads website

This repository is an Astro + Starlight documentation site for Manic Meads.

## Development commands

Run all commands from the repository root:

- `npm install`
- `npm run check`
- `npm run build`
- `npm run dev`

## Content conventions

- Documentation content lives in `src/content/docs/`.
- Articles (research) go in `src/content/docs/articles/`.
- Recipes go in `src/content/docs/recipes/`.
